  a x - a y = -2 * (x - y) * b x + 4 * (x - y) * b x * b y - (x - y) ^ 2 * b x * a y

Round115D.genuine_commutator_kernel_identity.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (phi : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (x y : HeckeIdeleClasses K) :
  ↑(a (genuineRealClassLog K x) - a (genuineRealClassLog K y)) * phi (x * y⁻¹) =
    -2 * ↑(b (genuineRealClassLog K x)) * (↑(genuineRealClassLog K (x * y⁻¹)) * phi (x * y⁻¹)) +
        4 * ↑(b (genuineRealClassLog K x)) * (↑(genuineRealClassLog K (x * y⁻¹)) * phi (x * y⁻¹)) *
          ↑(b (genuineRealClassLog K y)) -
      ↑(b (genuineRealClassLog K x)) * (↑(genuineRealClassLog K (x * y⁻¹)) ^ 2 * phi (x * y⁻¹)) *
        ↑(a (genuineRealClassLog K y))

        (∀ (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)), HasSum (fun i => inner ℂ (v i) F • u i) (T F)) ∧

                              (logModified (actualLog K) k theta))

                        ↑↑F y ∂mu) ∧

                  (∀ (n : ℕ), AEStronglyMeasurable (rho n) mu) →
                    (∀ᵐ (x : Classes K) ∂mu, Tendsto (fun n => rho n x) atTop (𝓝 1)) →
